population: English financial SMS, public source rights approved
control_veto: Explicit telco/prepaid balance notifications excluded even if machine reviewers accidentally approve them; personal chats and generic marketing excluded

family_policy.primary_pair_rule: Jaccard>=0.80 and structural>=0.80 OR structural>=0.92 and Jaccard>=0.45

split.source_holdout_scope: phishing-only if legitimate support absent; no invented specificity/AUC

small_class_ruling: If both-class train/validation/test support exists but desired300+300 is unavailable, train/evaluate only explicitly exploratory same-cohort models; no confirmatory generalization claims. Otherwise no research fitting.
ModernBERT: Exact pinned base, binary head, train/validation only; config modernbert_training.json

statistics.model_comparisons: paired exact McNemar, Holm across3comparisons; stratified paired bootstrap metric differences
statistics.tiny_test_note: Intervals/pvalues describe selected machine-reviewed data only

temporal: Not run without reliable original message timestamps and prospective cutoff
